findings.description: US-003 prescribed with_model_info_override("claude-sonnet-4.6"/"claude-opus-4.8", ...). test_codex.rs:283-300 does model_catalog.models.iter_mut().find(|m| m.slug == model).expect(...), and the bundled models-manager/models.json is GPT-only (gpt-5.5/5.4/5.4-mini/5.3-codex/5.2/codex-auto-review) — so a claude-* slug PANICS. Routing depends on wire_route + the gates, not the slug; test_codex uses the openai provider so the Copilot-side wire_route_for re-derivation does not run.
findings.resolution: US-003 setup, US-003 AC, OQ4, and the Risk Areas now prescribe overriding an EXISTING bundled slug: with_model_info_override("gpt-5.2", |mi| { mi.wire_route = ModelWireRoute::ChatCompletions; mi.supports_reasoning_summaries = false; mi.default_reasoning_level = Some(<level>); }). supports_reasoning_summaries=false is called out as load-bearing (client.rs:1690-1700: build_reasoning strips reasoning for such rows, and the SANDBOX-PATCH chat arm threads reasoning_effort explicitly) so the e2e exercises the threading path; openai_models.rs:802 confirms synthesized Claude rows default it false. OQ4 marked RESOLVED.

findings.sectionRef: Approach > US-003 NEW assertion; US-003 AC
findings.description: The flagship 'egress is /v1/chat/completions not /v1/messages' assertion was specified via a path() accessor on a ChatRequest captured by the chat mock mounted at /v1/chat/completions. That is tautological: a misroute to /v1/messages would 404 against the unmounted route and never be captured, so 'every captured request hit /v1/chat/completions' is true by construction and proves nothing about /v1/messages.
findings.resolution: Changed to a SERVER-level assertion: enumerate server.received_requests() and assert NO path matches /v1/messages AND >=1 matches /v1/chat/completions (optionally a /v1/messages recorder stub with ZERO hits). Reflected in US-003 strategy, US-003 AC, Risk Areas, and stories-outline.md.

findings.description: The e2e's correctness under the all-in-one core/tests/all.rs binary depends on cargo-nextest process-per-test isolation of the process-global anthropic gate (an AtomicBool re-derived per test_codex().build()). The plan's prior 'keep tests in one binary / set once' reasoning was insufficient — under plain cargo test (shared process) a parallel non-chat build() would clobber the gate OFF. The 'CI runs cargo test --workspace' note was in tension.
findings.resolution: Constraint 8 rewritten to state the nextest dependency (.config/nextest.toml process-per-test), to run via just test/nextest (not bare cargo test), install the gate after build() before the first turn, add a serial_test guard if ever under libtest, and note the e2e is skip_if_no_network! so the shared-process risk does not bite the CI cargo-test path. Mirrored in Risk Areas and US-003 stories AC.
